key_highlights: ASX set to tumble following a sharp Wall Street tech rout and global equity sell-off.
RBA hawkish rhetoric escalates with warnings of worsening inflation, raising odds of a fifth rate hike this year.
China-Australia iron ore disputes threaten earnings stability for major bulk miners.
Crude oil surges to multi-month highs, amplifying domestic stagflationary pressures alongside Snowy 2.0 cost blowouts.
Domestic tech and discretionary sectors face headwinds, evidenced by NextDC project delays and Nick Scali profit pressures.

sectors.trend: Global tech rout and AI fatigue spill into ASX, compounded by NextDC project delays in Melbourne.
sectors.implications: Multiple compression and heightened volatility across high-P/E tech and digital infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: Elevated RBA rate expectations intensify mortgage stress, falling home prices, and banking cost disciplines.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin benefits are increasingly countered by rising bad debt provisions and credit growth contraction.

sectors.trend: Bulk iron ore miners face rising Chinese trade friction, while domestic gold consolidation gains momentum.
sectors.implications: Downside risks for iron ore cash flows; gold and polymetallic explorers offer relative defensive shelter.

sectors.trend: Crude oil rallies to highs since May, while domestic energy transition costs escalate dramatically.
sectors.implications: Upstream hydrocarbon producers benefit from elevated pricing, but consumer energy bills remain sticky.

sectors.trend: Mounting cost-of-living pressures and mortgage burdens severely dampen retail spending.
sectors.implications: Earnings vulnerability across big-ticket furniture, hardware, and non-essential consumer retail stocks.

key_themes: Global technology sell-off and AI valuation repricing hitting Australian tech equities.
Hawkish RBA posture accelerating expectations of another interest rate hike amid persistent inflation.
Renewed trade friction with China over Australian iron ore pricing and volumes.
Spiking global crude prices adding to domestic energy transition challenges and Snowy 2.0 blowouts.
Accelerating residential property market weakness driven by surging listings and mortgage stress.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary and REITs; increase cash and floating-rate yields.
Trim high-multiple growth equities and capital-heavy tech infrastructure in favour of value assets.
Hedge exposure to bulk miners; pivot into gold producers and base metal diversifiers.
Maintain exposure to low-cost upstream oil and gas producers with high free cash flow generation.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers as safe haven and currency hedge
opportunities.rationale: Elevated macro uncertainty, AUD pressure, and active M&A consolidate upside for low-cost gold miners.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical allocation to cash-generative upstream energy
opportunities.rationale: Crude oil reaching multi-month highs provides strong earnings support and robust dividend yield potential.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight discretionary retail and housing-exposed cyclicals
defensive_moves.rationale: Accelerating mortgage strain, RBA rate hike risks, and dropping home values hit discretionary budgets.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-beta tech and delayed infrastructure operators
defensive_moves.rationale: Nasdaq valuation contraction and domestic expansion delays heighten execution and re-rating risks.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish bias over the next 1–3 months as the ASX digests global tech weakness, hawkish RBA rhetoric, and housing deceleration.
market_outlook.long_term: Medium-term (6–12 months) stabilization contingent on peaking inflation, clear terminal RBA rates, and resilient resource exports.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and updated inflation forecasts
Quarterly Australian CPI and labour market data releases
Sino-Australian trade announcements regarding iron ore procurement
US Big Tech quarterly earnings results and AI capex outlooks
watch_list: Brent and WTI crude oil price benchmarks
Australian housing market clearance rates and listing volumes
